name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Aeon)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 218
Aura faint conjuration CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 7,800 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring is forged from black iron and shining silver. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, he adds paracletusB2 to the 3rd-level list of monsters he can summon, adds theletosB2 to the 6th-level list, and adds akhanaB2 to the 9th-level list. Also, once per day the wearer summon a paracletus, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be neutral with no other alignment components; Cost 3,900 gp
